title: Ukrainian Beet Soup
description: A hearty, comforting soup made with beets, served in a bowl.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, heat the oil over medium heat.
2. Add the chopped beets and cook for 5 minutes, until slightly tender.
3. Add 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
4. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, until the beets are tender.
5. Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
6. Season with salt and zesty to taste.
7. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
